_comment: Per-profile tier overrides for the generated compatibility matrix. Each key is a '<product>/<profile>' selector. The value is a per-object-type tier (E2E Verified, Adapter-Compatible, Manual / Rebuild, Not Applicable) or a per-(scope, object_type) override keyed by '<scope>:<object_type>'. Higher priority than registry policy + E2E detection; lower than direct edits to registry-v2.json.
